create.name: Dr. Roger Jahnke
create.bio:
Dr. Roger Jahnke, a doctor of Chinese medicine and a teacher of tai chi and qigong, has practised acupuncture and traditional Chinese medicine clinically for more than three decades and has made ten research and cultural journeys to China. In 2000 he set up IIQTC, his Institute of Integral Qigong and Tai Chi, based in Santa Barbara, California, and he remains its director and lead trainer. Thousands of qigong and tai chi teachers and practice leaders have trained with the institute and its faculty, today mostly through modular certification online.

He calls his approach Integral Qigong: a combination of gentle movement, breath practice, self-applied massage and meditation. He also created Tai Chi Easy, a simplified practice intended for beginners and for community classes. His books are The Healer Within and The Healing Promise of Qi, the latter drawing on more than twenty forms of qigong and tai chi, both traditional and modern. He has taught at Esalen, Omega and other centres, and offers live and self-paced programmes on The Shift Network.

books.title: The Healing Promise of Qi: Creating Extraordinary Wellness Through Qigong and Tai Chi
books.author: Roger Jahnke
books.description: A guide to building a personal qigong and tai chi practice, drawing on more than twenty traditional and modern forms. It explains the ideas behind qi cultivation and shows how to shape a daily routine around movement, breath and meditation.

books.title: The Healer Within: Using Traditional Chinese Techniques To Release Your Body's Own Medicine, Movement, Massage, Meditation, Breathing
books.author: Roger Jahnke
books.description: Roger Jahnke's first book, presenting four simple self-care practices from the Chinese tradition: gentle movement, self-applied massage, breathing and meditation. The practices are short and adaptable to any daily routine.

books.title: Tai Chi Easy Practice Leader Training Guide
books.author: Roger Jahnke
books.description: The training manual for Tai Chi Easy, the simplified practice Roger Jahnke developed for beginners. It is written for people preparing to lead community practice groups.

courses.title: IIQTC Online Level 1 Integral Qigong Teacher Training
courses.description: The institute's Level 1 qigong teacher training, delivered online in three modules through video lessons, Zoom gatherings, practice teaching and small mastermind groups. It aims to prepare students to lead qigong classes by the end of the course.

courses.title: Activate Your Inner Healing Elixirs With the 10 Phases of Qi Cultivation
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced course on The Shift Network exploring the 10 Phases of Qi Cultivation. It works with the three dantians through qigong movement, breath and meditation to harmonise body, mind and spirit.

free_resources.title: The Tai Chi & Qigong Way Free Library
free_resources.description: A free membership library from Roger Jahnke and the IIQTC with instructional videos, including Tai Chi Easy, guided audio practices for breathing and meditation, talks and articles. Sign-up with an email address is required.
